description: FHA-insured HUD Section 232 assisted living loans from HUD's active-loan file: a state's (or the US) count, outstanding balance, median note rate, loans at 5%+, endorsements since FY2001, and the loans themselves (property, city, units, note rate, balance, endorsed, maturity, FHA number). Filter by name, type or minimum rate.

limit.description: Loans to return, 1 to 20 (page with offset for more).

min_rate.description: Only loans with a note rate at or above this percent, e.g. 5.

name.description: Part of a property name or city as HUD lists it, e.g. "Regency" or "Huntsville".

sort.description: Sort order: balance (largest first), rate (highest first), maturity (soonest first), endorsed (newest first).

state.description: US state or DC: two-letter code (e.g. TX) or full name (e.g. "Texas"). Omit to search every state.

name: get_hud_232_assisted_living_loans
title: HUD Section 232 assisted living loans
